name: it-network-eng-sims
description: IT network engineering simulations ported to Rust/WebAssembly for interactive web demos with SvelteKit UI.
author: uni-projects-demos

scripts.dev:all: npm run wasm:build:dev && npm run dev
scripts.build:all: npm run wasm:build && npm run build
scripts.verify:be: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.verify:fix:be: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --fix --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features --allow-dirty --allow-staged --allow-no-vcs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:be && npm run verify:fe
scripts.verify:fix: npm run verify:fix:fe && npm run verify:fix:be
